# OWNER source/domain/hosted-CI independent checkpoint — PR #58 (2026-11-12)

**Verdict: `RA3D_D1D2_SOURCE_AND_OLD_BASE_CI_PASS_CANDIDATE`, NOT `PR58_OWNER_FINAL_PASS`.** Exact tested PR HEAD `c849d3d01a2af976bfe0cdef4fabb7f840bfbd37`, but hosted final workflow still tested against **old main `e40201bf399cc8c5d11a708fcbe33c31f01e67b2`**. The now-accepted main is **`a185f9ce7e67904f2c0aef854716ca9844144592`** after Owner-merged docs-only Chinese reviewer UX PR #56. This is the sole remaining current final-integration gate, **not** a newly found RA3D D1/D2 functional defect; do not rewrite domain code to address it.

Independent inspection performed:
- Full original source read: `vrae/reviewing/{canonical,target,proposals,simulation}.py`; test source `tests/reviewing/{test_offline_contract,test_deep_refusals,test_strict_metadata}.py`; D1 compatibility source, Phase0 mapping, deterministic scenario receipts. Verified actual source replay uses original `EvidencePack.load`, `FindingPackage.load`, `ReportDraft.load`, native H0/source/Guard and original HTML; original source/quote byte spans and per-claim type ceiling are checked. 404 = source-bound one finding, 200 = coverage-only with native null, no fake finding/APPROVE.
- Source code's `prepare_production_review` unconditionally refuses with `D_AUTHENTICATED_PRODUCTION_REVIEW_NOT_IMPLEMENTED`; `TestOnlyActor`, `SyntheticTrust`, object refs, clock and `InMemoryReviewSimulation` are visibly nondurable/synthetic. Code does not call `approve_version` or `check_share` and creates no native real ReviewDecision, APPPROVED report, ShareGrant or external access. Simulation receipts explicitly set `native_decision/native_approval/share_grant=null`, `external_visibility=false`, `durable=false`. Future Phase0 A01–A48 authenticated/DB/production conditions remain NOT_RUN/BLOCKED.
- Full recursive Git trees independently compared: **all 2,628 accepted-old-main blobs and modes preserved byte-for-byte**, exactly 101 new paths and **zero** altered/removed paths. All new paths inside the authorized three trees `vrae/reviewing/**`, `tests/reviewing/**`, `docs/03-engineering/ra3d-d1d2-offline/**`. Historical RA3C QA/Gold, schemas/OpenAPI, CI, dependencies, reporting, Guard, Docker are untouched.
- D1 actual 404/200 dual-runtime records and original `py11/reviewing.xml`, `py13/reviewing.xml` JUnit independently inspected: each **127/127 PASS**, 0 FAIL/ERROR/SKIP/XFAIL. Negative controls include forged fact/source, invalid policy and bool-as-int, byte/hash/HTML/Guard tamper, forbidden actor/tenant, stale version, sequential CAS/idempotency, zero-issue escalation. Original initial local stopped/nonzero logs and bool/int anomaly are retained.
- [GitHub run 43213661480](https://github.com/gloweaseco-leo/VRAE/actions/runs/43213661480): original four jobs individually read; **4/4 SUCCESS** on exact test merge `48142525c9927cedaed07b8482c16f8f325e0dd0`; its actual ordered parents **`e40201bf399cc8c5d11a708fcbe33c31f01e67b2` + `c849d3d01a2af976bfe0cdef4fabb7f840bfbd37`**, not latest main. Python3.11/3.13 each **2188 PASS/25 old SKIP**, isolated-http **2212 PASS/1 old SKIP**, isolated-browser SUCCESS. Parsed raw `RA3D_D1D2_ACTUAL_RECEIPT` in Python3.11, Python3.13, isolated HTTP: **127 actual passed calls /0 errors each**, matching 13 pinned source hashes, native approvals=0, real human decisions=0, share grants=0. Same jobs contain RA3C QA V2 **64 primary +54 denials actually passed**. HTTP original records 24 network isolation negatives with no external egress or bait connection.

## Codex1 minimal FINAL gate, previously requested but still outstanding at readback
1. Work only in existing isolated PR58 worktree: `git fetch origin`, independently assert current `origin/main=a185f9ce7e67904f2c0aef854716ca9844144592`, then ordinary `git merge --no-edit origin/main`. No rebase/cherry-pick/force, no modification to Codex2's RA4C0 Issue60 branch. Resolve any conflict only within owned paths or STOP for Owner.
2. Prove **all accepted latest-main blobs/modes** preserved except additions in the three Issue57-owned directories. In particular retain PR56's UI/dossiers and current QA frozen V1/V2, Docker allowlist, original reporting/Guard. Exact 13 D1/D2 source/input blob SHAs and native 404/200 outputs must remain unchanged.
3. Rerun **four truly new hosted GitHub jobs** on exact final PR58 HEAD + newly accepted main, inspect actual checkout merge-ref ordered parents and each job raw log. Full suites must actually collect and pass 127 RA3D reviewing and 118 RA3C V2 in the Python3.11/3.13/isolated HTTP jobs, with original network negatives and isolated browser. Record real counts, FAIL/ERROR/SKIP honestly. This previous 4/4 old-main run is not sufficient as the final merge gate.
4. Read-only D1 hash/source audit at final HEAD and confirm no actual approval/share; preserve earlier JUnit/logs and stage-specific proof without changing historical files or weakening assertions. If source mismatch, report before minimal repair.
5. Submit exact final SHA, 4 job URLs, merge-ref parents, immutable source audit and new results; retain Draft/NO-MERGE until separate Owner FINAL PASS. On approval Owner merges and closes Issue #57.

**Project management:** Codex2 separately proceeds [RA4C0 Issue #60](https://github.com/gloweaseco-leo/VRAE/issues/60) on latest main without waiting. Codex1 moves next into RA4A DB/RLS/queue after its PR58 approved, not back to expanding unrelated RA2. Human Gold 0/26; authenticated review, durable decisions, paid provider, real site, ShareGrant, customer delivery and production deploy remain NO-GO.
